corrections.why: The county is Loudoun: Wikipedia and the 1937 item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page both use that spelling. The Forest Lookouts heading and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list spell it Loudon.

notes_for_editor: Only one dated record was found: a 1937 newspaper item quoted on Forest Lookouts (the Farmer's Advocate, as credited there; original not checked). No build date, builder, tower design or removal date found. The 120-foot figure is the item's 'perched 120 feet in the air' and may describe the watch position rather than the tower's height, so no height_m is recorded. The brief's county spelling 'Loudon' is a correction. Ownership of the tower site is not identified; Wikipedia says the National Park Service owns a small portion of the mountain and the rest is privately held, so no access level is recorded for the tower site. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 4 page reads. Virginia Chronicle was blocked (HTTP 403) and was not used.
